catalogue_reconciliation.scope: SIAM Volume4 section8 has eleven chapters. Existing analysis import had all except Zhang; Seeger and Peluse are retained as separately sourced/cross-listed entries. This is a proceedings comparison, not a claim that the dynamically loaded official speaker directory was fully extracted.

normalization_and_corrections: Use site angle convention exp(-ix·xi); extension has no prefactor, inverse Fourier has (2pi)^(-n); lattice dual is 2pi B^(-T) Z^n and uses vee, not existing deleted-zero star notation.
Fourier-support hats restored where the report prints supp f instead of supp hat f.
Bochner–Riesz integration domain is radius R rather than the report's inconsistent unit-ball display.
Cone square function stated in the original theorem's frequency-sector form, not by silently identifying each sector with one spatial wave packet.
Global l2 decoupling range is 2<=p<=2(n+1)/(n-1); report's simplified 1<=p version not imported as a global theorem.
Positive-definite quadratic form retains the complex conjugate; optimized scalar coefficient proves a stronger pair constant 1/(2K^2).
Flattening equivalence uses an L2 convolution density; mere L1 density is not asserted equivalent to finite-p Fourier integrability.
Parabola lattice lower bound stated at square scales R=N^2; rational-time Gauss discussion links the odd-modulus, coprime-coefficient result.
Bourgain entropy only recorded in an explicit fixed-threshold weaker form; not equated with all scale-loss variants.
deferred: General wave-packet decomposition with coefficient estimates, epsilon-removal, bilinear restriction and the full Stein–Tomas proof remain cited research/analytic inputs; the concrete smooth paraboloid packet and necessary exponent are proved locally.
BCT multilinear restriction, Bourgain–Demeter decoupling, Guth–Wang–Zhang cone square function and Carleson sharp thresholds are cited, not reconstructed proofs.
Polynomial partition existence, bounded-complexity volume/tube estimates and Katz–Rogers nonconcentration remain cited. Finite-field Dvir and line/shrunken-cell counting are proved locally.

Bourgain normal-form invariance and necessity, nested variable-coefficient Wolff conditions and constant-curvature characterization are not re-proved. The explicit curved compression and failure of the scalar Hessian condition at its origin are calculated.

Parsell–Vinogradov stationary-set method, refined decoupling and o-minimal integration theorems are not reconstructed. Monomial surface and moment-counting identity are supplied; existing tame-geometry overview reused.
Entropy conjecture and high-dimensional extrapolations remain conjectural. No proof of lattice-weight ellipse separation, PFR structure theorem or quantitative flattening theorem is claimed.
Cairo and Cairo–Zhang counterexample constructions are cited with their distinct log/power and fixed/moving surface scopes; no complete construction is claimed.

entries: 研究问题、三种集中形状及应用的叙事综述；不把导航边当作数学前置。
曲面密度、参数测度及角频率归一化明确。
配对恒等式及双向范数估计；零测曲面上的限制由连续延拓定义。
单帽相位下界、体积和Lp幂次比较逐步证明。
球面限制猜想的量词与对偶指数，状态限定于所引报告。
Stein–Tomas研究定理引用，球面Knapp必要指数另作推导。
光滑帽换元与分部积分给出带快速尾部的具体波包。
圆锥生成、角向与法向尺度分开计算。
统一行列式下界，区别于两两角度分离。
BCT临界输出与局部R-epsilon损失按原定理核对。
自由演化符号、方程和L2连续性明确。
维数阈值、频率支撑与高维端点状态分别陈述。
复系数随机符号四阶矩的配对展开。
频率扇片形式的原始圆锥平方函数定理，区别于波包及范数平方和。
中间尺度Rs^2,Rs,R；随机均匀重叠仅作为显式模型假设。
补实数阶Sobolev定义，与已有H1页互补而不复制。
全球解耦的正确p>=2范围与频率小帽尺度。
包括两个端点的积分配对范数公式。
固定复杂度约定及与尺度参数独立的意义。
方向分离的半代数非集中研究定理；与假设型Wolff条件区别。
多项式分割存在定理，质量界和胞腔数均明确。
一元根计数与去墙厚管几何证明，保留轴在零集内的情形。
有限域Kakeya定义独立于实数体积。
逐变量次数小于域大小的插值唯一性。
维数构造、最高齐次部分及零方向的处理。
Bochner–Riesz定义、积分半径、alpha零端点与一般p猜想。
乘子有界及支配收敛证明。
混合秩与法向Hessian条件，不依赖未定义Gauss外积。
明确参数曲线x2=t x1，逐项验证H1/H2及二维压缩。
规范坐标中的Bourgain条件；不把任意坐标公式当不变量。
高余维单项式曲面及参数测度。
有限和展开及整数指数正交给出精确解数。
角频率对偶格的2pi常数与vee记号。
周期化、系数计算及Fejer唯一性证明Poisson公式。
有限指数和的精确峰值及小邻域，Gauss条件链接已有页。
正定二次式、Hermitian对称与正谱权重例子。
相位对齐和优化零点系数，保留共轭并给出大值差常数。
差集倍增定义和区间、整数盒、子群例子。
L2密度与L2k Fourier可积性的精确等价，区分L1密度。
投影落在平移格中时卷积仍集中于可数超平面。
直线积分与加权能量的定义，指出原估计已被反驳。
引用Cairo反例，明确log与幂次损失、固定与变动曲面的区别。
仅在平方尺度给出显式抛物线格点下界。
Fejer核、乘积逼近和连续周期Fourier唯一性证明。
有限测度卷积、总质量及Fourier乘法，从积分定义出发。
固定阈值的熵猜想及Knapp所强制的方格数。
正式出处、补充论文版本、署名许可及归一化。
